title: Lock-Song Adjudicator
text: Lock-Song Adjudicator broadcasts obsolete prison verdicts until the expedition's instruments begin enforcing them. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The sentence survived everyone named in it.

defeatReward.text: Lock-Song Adjudicator is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
